sections.h2: Why Real Estate Teams Lose Leads

paragraphs.text: Property buyers enquire on several portals and websites at once. The developer who replies first, with the right details, usually gets the site visit. Yet many sales teams reply hours later, follow up once or twice, and lose track of leads across portals, calls, WhatsApp chats and spreadsheets.
Automation fixes the response gap. Every enquiry receives an instant, helpful reply, is logged in one place and is followed up until the buyer books a visit or clearly declines.

sections.h2: What Our Real Estate Automation Covers

items.title: Real Estate Lead Automation
items.text: Real estate lead automation captures enquiries from your website, Meta and Google ads, and property portals, removes duplicates, records the source and assigns each lead to the right salesperson within seconds.

items.title: Property Portal Lead Integration
items.text: Property portal lead integration connects listings on major portals to your CRM or sheet, wherever the portal offers lead exports, email alerts or an API, so no enquiry stays trapped in a portal inbox.

items.title: Real Estate Chatbot
items.html: A real estate chatbot on your website answers questions about projects, locations, sizes, amenities, approvals and price ranges, collects buyer requirements and books site visits, at any hour and in English or Malayalam.

items.title: WhatsApp Automation for Builders
items.html: WhatsApp automation for builders sends brochures, floor plans, location maps and price sheets instantly on the official WhatsApp Business Platform, followed by planned reminders and updates for interested buyers.

items.title: Property Enquiry Automation
items.text: Property enquiry automation asks qualifying questions, such as budget, preferred location, configuration, timeline and loan needs, then scores and routes each lead so salespeople call the most serious buyers first.

items.title: AI Property Recommendations
items.text: AI property recommendations match buyer requirements with your available units or listings and suggest the best options, which is useful for brokers with large inventories and developers with multiple projects.

items.title: Site Visit Booking Automation
items.text: Site visit booking automation lets buyers choose a slot, confirms the visit, sends directions and reminders, notifies the site team and requests feedback afterwards.

items.title: Real Estate Follow-Up Automation
items.text: Real estate follow-up automation keeps in touch with leads over weeks or months with project updates, offers, construction progress and event invitations, and alerts salespeople when a buyer re-engages.

paragraphs.text: Real estate CRM workflows track every lead from first enquiry to site visit, negotiation, booking and registration. Stages update automatically, tasks are created for each next step and managers see live pipeline reports by project, source and salesperson. We work with Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce and real estate CRMs, or set up a simple CRM if you do not have one.

sections.h2: AI for Real Estate Agents and Brokers

paragraphs.text: AI for real estate agents saves time on daily tasks. An AI property description writer drafts listing descriptions from basic details for agents to edit. AI tools summarise buyer conversations, draft follow-up messages and prepare comparisons of shortlisted properties. Agents spend less time typing and more time showing properties.

sections.h2: AI Automation for Builders and Developers
sections.intro: AI automation for builders and developers also covers post-sale work: payment milestone reminders, construction progress updates, document collection for bank loans, handover scheduling and customer support during and after possession.

items.title: RERA Document Automation
items.text: RERA document automation helps teams collect and organise the project information, progress updates and documents needed for regulatory reporting and buyer communication. Your legal and compliance team still reviews and approves every submission.

paragraphs.text: Property management automation helps landlords and managers handle rental properties with less effort. Rent collection reminders go out automatically with payment links, maintenance requests are logged and assigned, lease renewals are flagged in advance and owners receive monthly statements.

sections.h2: AI Automation for NRI Property Buyers

paragraphs.text: AI automation for NRI property buyers handles the time-zone gap. Buyers in the Gulf, Europe and North America get instant replies, virtual tour links, document checklists and call scheduling in their own time zone, and salespeople receive a clear summary before calling back.

sections.h2: Can AI Help Sell Property Faster?

paragraphs.text: Can AI help sell property faster? AI does not replace good projects, fair pricing or skilled salespeople. What it does well is remove delays: instant replies, consistent follow-up, better lead prioritisation and fewer missed site visits. These improvements help your team convert more of the enquiries you already receive. During project launches, when enquiries can multiply overnight, automation also ensures that every interested buyer receives the brochure, price details and a visit invitation within minutes rather than days.

items.title: We Build the Whole Funnel
items.text: We design real estate websites, landing pages and project microsites, and we connect them to automation, so lead capture and follow-up work together.

items.title: Local Market Understanding
items.text: Our team in Kochi understands how Kerala buyers search, enquire and decide, including the large share of NRI buyers. AI automation for real estate Kerala developers book with us is designed around these habits.

sections.h2: How Much Does Real Estate Automation Cost?

paragraphs.text: How much does real estate automation cost? It depends on the number of projects, lead sources, users, messaging volumes and AI features. Costs include a one-time setup fee, CRM and messaging charges, AI usage and optional monthly support starting from Rs. 3,000 per month. We provide a written estimate after reviewing your sales process.
Ask us for a real estate automation case study. We share client details only with permission and can demonstrate example chatbots, WhatsApp flows and dashboards on a call.

items.q: Will buyers know they are talking to automation?
items.a: Yes. Chatbots and automated messages identify themselves, and buyers can ask for a salesperson at any time. Being open about automation builds trust, and most buyers simply appreciate getting accurate, useful answers quickly, even late at night, on weekends or on busy public holidays across Kerala.

items.q: Can it work with our existing CRM?
items.a: Usually yes. We connect to most CRMs through their integrations or APIs.

items.q: Do we need a big sales team to benefit?
items.a: No. Small brokerages and single-project developers often benefit most, because automation handles the replies and reminders that a two or three person team cannot keep up with during launches and weekends.

items.q: Can enquiries in Malayalam be handled?
items.a: Yes. Chatbots and WhatsApp replies can understand and respond in Malayalam, English and mixed Manglish messages, and we test them with real buyer questions before launch.

Most clients start with instant replies and lead capture from every source, because that alone stops leads from going cold. AI automation for real estate then grows step by step into site visit booking, long-term follow-up, CRM reporting and post-sale communication, as your team becomes comfortable with each stage.

We recommend tracking first response time, the share of leads contacted, site visits booked, visit-to-booking rate and cost per booking by source. These figures show clearly whether automation is improving sales.
